## Content Quality

- [ ] No implementation details as *decisions* — the spec's Q1–Q5 answers stay the reader's own words; the
  mechanism (provider presets, prompt composition, transport) points at `lib/ai/`, `lib/reading_view.dart`,
  `lib/services/content_store.dart` only as evidence the tree already carries.
- [ ] Focused on user value — the reader's own line is the spine: "add AI access for Kalahoo Reading"; the
  configuration and the prompt dialog are the affordances, not the value.
- [ ] Written for non-technical stakeholders — the mechanism stays in the Clarifications' answers and the
  Assumptions; the FR/SC ids speak of provider selection, prompt, content and failure, not of a platform API.
- [ ] All mandatory sections completed — header, `Input`, the "What this feature does" paragraph, Clarifications
  (Q1–Q5), User Scenarios & Testing (one story, three scenarios), Edge Cases, Requirements + Key Entities
  (AIProvider, AIPrompt), Success Criteria, Assumptions, Out of scope.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain — the reader's answers Q1–Q5 are bound here at this stage.
- [ ] Requirements are testable and unambiguous — every FR names an observable: FR-001 the top tool bar Settings

- [ ] All acceptance scenarios are defined — one story, three scenarios; the Settings/AI configuration, the Edit
